title: TransactionDeclined
description: One declined authorization call publishes one TransactionDeclined event. Six payload fields name the attempt and the reason it failed, shaped after the 80-byte validation trailer at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L180-L182 and the 350-byte daily transaction record at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy. Five envelope fields precede them, and the envelope is additive in full: no source record carries one. Evolution and version policy: card-platform/docs/event-flow.md (planned).
$comment: app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L370-L378 runs the card cross-reference check first and the account check only while the reason code is still zero, so one event carries one code. The oneOf block below pins each reason code to the one description the source writes beside it, so a code paired with another code's text fails validation. aggregateId and accountId carry one account identifier, and the Kafka message key is that value, so the key and the payload cannot disagree.

eventId.description: The idempotency key, a lower-case canonical Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of thirty-six characters. A consumer checks this identifier against its own processed_event table before it acts. It then writes its side effects and the marker row in one local transaction, and acknowledges the message only after that transaction commits. The pattern is asserted directly, so validation does not depend on the validator enabling the optional format-assertion vocabulary. Additive. No source field exists.

eventType.description: The routing discriminator. A consumer reads this field to learn which payload arrived. Additive. No source field exists.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. This file is version 1, matching the -v1 suffix in its name. Additive. No source field exists.

occurredAt.description: The publish timestamp, in Coordinated Universal Time. The authorization service stamps it when it writes the event. This document declares no separate authorization timestamp, so occurredAt is the only time it carries. Additive. No source field exists.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier, eleven digits, and always the Kafka message key. Width from XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy:L7. The Kafka message key, this field and the payload field accountId all carry one value, so account identity has a single source. A publisher compares the key against both fields and rejects the message on any difference.

transactionId.description: The transaction identifier, sixteen characters. From TRAN-ID PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy:L5 and DALYTRAN-ID at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L5.

accountId.description: The account identifier, eleven digits, and the same value aggregateId carries. Width from XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy:L7. A text field keeps a leading zero, and a consumer maps this field onto its own account column.

declineReasonCode.description: The reject reason code, four digits zero-padded to the width the source writes. From WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON PIC 9(04) at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L181. These four values are the whole set: 0100 at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L385, 0101 at L397, 0102 at L410, and 0103 at L417. Any other code fails validation. The oneOf block at the root of this document binds each code to the one text the source writes beside it.

declineReasonDescription.description: The reject reason text that pairs with the code, reproduced character for character from the source. From WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC PIC X(76) at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L182. The four texts sit at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L386, L398, L411 and L418. The declineReason keyword at the root of this schema binds each text to one code.

amount.description: The attempted amount as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From DALYTRAN-AMT PIC S9(09)V99 at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L10, so nine digits sit before the point. A leading minus is valid. 50 of the 300 records in app/data/ASCII/dailytran.txt hold a negative amount.
amount.$comment: app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L548-L551 adds a non-negative amount to the cycle credit accumulator and a negative amount to the cycle debit accumulator.

maskedCardNumber.description: The card number with twelve asterisks in place of the leading digits and the last four digits left visible. Position and width from DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L15. The masking is additive: no source program masks a Primary Account Number (PAN), and app/bms/COCRDSL.bms:L96-L99 defines the card detail field at the full sixteen characters. The authorization decision runs on the full PAN, and masking happens where the event is serialized. The cross-reference read at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L382-L383 keys on all sixteen characters.

extensions.description: Optional, bounded room for additive evolution inside this version. A later producer puts a new value here and a consumer on this version still validates the event, which is what keeps a new consumer from breaking an existing one. The object is closed in every other direction: at most 16 members, each name a short identifier, each value a string of at most 256 characters, and no nested object or array. A field that belongs to the event contract is declared above instead; this object never carries a Primary Account Number, a card verification value or any other sensitive value. Additive. No source field exists.
